name: elabora
description: Work on Elabora e-learning modules: connects the elabora command installed on this computer, with its tools, skills and documentation at its own version.

interface.shortDescription: Write and check e-learning modules with Elabora
interface.longDescription: Elabora is a local-first authoring tool for e-learning. This plugin connects the elabora command installed with the Elabora app: the plan, screens, design, quizzes, dialogues, narration, translation, checks and SCORM packages of the module in the session's folder, with the guidance of the Elabora version you use.
